claims.assertion: Swaruu says ships navigate time by matching a destination’s frequency; each vessel’s emulation capacity limits its reach.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes choices as shifts among existing timelines, while each person experiences one apparent sequence.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Changing the past yields a different future for the traveler, but leaves the departure timeline unchanged.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says timeline jumps benefit only the traveler; strategic changes do not affect others, though small tactical combat jumps may work.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
